notes: 🔢 Max open positions is now 20 in all three ready-made rule sets, so tapping a preset never takes that number away again (previously Defender set 6, All-rounder 8, Hunter 5 — and a preset tap overwrote whatever you'd typed). One honest note: with 1% risk per trade, twenty open positions can mean up to ~20% of the account at risk at once — in practice the evidence and score gates rarely offer that many qualifying shares in a day, so treat it as a ceiling rather than a target. Tooltips and the lesson describing the presets were updated to match.
